extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Pasco County has a $45 monthly premium, a $510 drug deductible and a $5400 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

superlatives.text: Honestly, this is the best plan in Pasco County, nobody beats it.

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits, and collected the Scope of Appointment. However, the agent used a superlative that could be misleading.
composition.coaching_note: Dana used a superlative, 'Honestly, this is the best plan in Pasco County, nobody beats it,' which could be seen as misleading. It's important to provide balanced information and avoid making absolute claims.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign the Scope of Appointment, schedule a follow-up call in 48 hours.
